text:
meera: Heads up — after the SAML mapping change we pushed last night ~50 users were JIT-provisioned with NO roles. Repro steps below, tagging security-oncall.
sam: Is this the mapping that extracts roles from the `roles` attribute with a regex?
meera: Yes. The Okta inline transform we deployed is: `user.roles.replace(/.*roles=(.*);?.*/, '$1')` — it looks like it returns an empty string when eduPersonPrincipalName has a plus sign or other special chars.
alex: Can you paste an assertion example?
meera: Sure — here's the stripped assertion we captured from the failing flow:
```
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="urn:oid:1.3.6.1.4.1.5923.1.1.1.6">
    <AttributeValue>john+test@example.com</AttributeValue>
  </Attribute>
  <Attribute Name="urn:custom:roles">
    <AttributeValue>roles=team:viewer;org:member</AttributeValue>
  </Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>
```
alex: Hmm the role attr is present, but the transform might be choking on the `+` in the EPN because of URL encoding or because Okta's JS runtime coerces to different string.
okta-bot: Mapping change deployed by meera at 2026-03-19T18:04Z :white_check_mark:
jana: We're seeing JIT fall back to the default role `organization_admin` for some orgs when roles parse to empty — that's dangerous.
security-oncall: Impact list: internal-test-org, customer-a, customer-b reported missing admin dashboards. Recommend rollback of mapping until we confirm a fix.
sam: Quick mitigation: change transform to a defensive extraction rather than a single regex, e.g. `var r = String(user['urn:custom:roles']||''); r = r.split(';').find(x => x.includes('org:')) || null;` — and explicitly `|| null` so JIT doesn't treat empty string as valid and assign admin default.
meera: I pushed a patch to Okta to use `String(user['urn:custom:roles']||'').split(';')` and added a fallback mapping that assigns `org:member` instead of `organization_admin` when no role found. Testing now.
alex: We should also scan audit logs for `jit_provision` where roles == [] and correlate to assertion payloads. Sample audit line we saw:
```
{"event":"jit_provision","user":"john+test@example.com","roles":[],"assertion_present":true}
```
meera: Logged SENTRY issue and created runbook: https://confluence.redwood.internal/security/jit-saml-role-loss-2026. Action items in ticket: verify transform for URL-encoded chars, add unit tests for EPN variants, revert mapping if any more incidents come in.
security-oncall: Creating incident INC-2026-342, paging eng-oncall for rollback window at 20:00 UTC.
sam: Also recommend a short-lived mitigation: add an Okta inline expression to sanitize `+` -> `%2B` before regex, and add a `roles !== ''` guard.
meera: Confirmed quick-fix applied to production mapping at 2026-03-19T18:22Z. Early check: impacted orgs show roles populated again. Please monitor.
jana: :eyes: I also added a note to RBAC docs about JIT default behavior so we don't accidentally escalate when role parsing fails.
alex: After monitoring window, we should schedule a postmortem and add an automated check in the SSO CI that varies EPN characters.
security-oncall: Thanks — keeping incident open until 2026-03-20 02:00 UTC. meera, please include KMS/audit log pointers in the postmortem so compliance can verify no privilege escalation occurred.
meera: Will do. I'll attach the raw audit export and Okta mapping diff to the incident ticket.
sam: :thumbsup:
meera: Will follow up with the postmortem and a preventative change request to treat missing roles as `org:member` not admin.
